An exception applies to cases in which prior consent can not be obtained for reasons of fact and the processing of the data is permitted by law. 2. We delete or block the personal data of the data subject as soon as the purpose of the storage is fulfilled. It may also be stored if provided for by the European or national legislator in EU regulations, laws or regulations to which our company is subject (see details in sections 3.1-3.3).
